definitions.explanation: Items that one carries or owns; things that belong to a person.

notes:
{持|も}ち{物|もの} refers to items one carries or brings along, especially in organized settings like school events, travel, or security checks.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have, hold) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {持|も}ち{物|もの}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: belongings check/inspection
- {持|も}ち{物|もの}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: packing list, list of things to bring
- ⟦{貴重|きちょう}{品|ひん}→貴重品：15344_kichouhin⟧: valuables (related term)
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧: forgotten item, lost property

USAGE:
- School events: ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{物|もの} (field trip supplies)
- Security: {持|も}ち{物|もの}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (baggage inspection)
- Travel: {持|も}ち{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to check one's belongings)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧: luggage, baggage — larger items for transport
- ⟦{所持品|しょじひん}→所持品：20346_shojihin⟧: possessions — formal/legal term
